mapper.select: select l.loan_id, l.subject_id, l.item_name, l.item_type, l.asset_no, l.quantity, l.borrower_name, l.borrower_phone, l.borrower_org, l.borrower_remark, l.borrow_date, l.expected_return_date, l.actual_return_date, l.status, l.related_flow_id, l.voucher_object_id, l.note, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.deleted, s.name as subject_name from audit_loan l left join audit_subject s on l.subject_id = s.subject_id where l.loan_id = #{loanId} and l.deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into audit_loan
subject_id, item_name, item_type, asset_no, quantity, borrower_name, borrower_phone, borrower_org, borrower_remark, borrow_date, expected_return_date, actual_return_date, status, related_flow_id, voucher_object_id, note, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
values
#{subjectId}, #{itemName}, #{itemType}, #{assetNo}, #{quantity}, #{borrowerName}, #{borrowerPhone}, #{borrowerOrg}, #{borrowerRemark}, #{borrowDate}, #{expectedReturnDate}, #{actualReturnDate}, #{status}, #{relatedFlowId}, #{voucherObjectId}, #{note}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now()
mapper.update: update audit_loan set deleted = 1, update_time = now() where loan_id = #{loanId}
mapper.select: select r.review_log_id, r.loan_id, r.action, r.operator_id, r.operator, r.role, r.advice, r.create_time, u.nick_name from audit_loan_review_log r left join sys_user u on r.operator_id = u.user_id where r.loan_id = #{loanId} order by r.create_time asc, r.review_log_id asc

select l.loan_id, l.subject_id, l.item_name, l.item_type, l.asset_no, l.quantity, l.borrower_name, l.borrower_phone, l.borrower_org, l.borrower_remark, l.borrow_date, l.expected_return_date, l.actual_return_date, l.status, l.related_flow_id, l.voucher_object_id, l.note, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.deleted, s.name as subject_name from audit_loan l left join audit_subject s on l.subject_id = s.subject_id where l.deleted = 0 and l.status = 'BORROWED' and l.expected_return_date is not null and l.expected_return_date < #{now}
